amendment_reason: Independent review of v1 found 11/4608 budget-7 static-baseline worlds fell back to an all-class uniform portfolio despite acquired zero-weight reports being present. Fix this support-constraint bug, preserve v1 evidence, and use new heldout worlds. No change to endpoint, risk grid, budgets, training, calibration, validation or success criteria.
scope: Closed-world learned multimodal generation with a finite NDU-inspired controller; not a foundation model, neural FBSDE solver, native Hepta integration, or joint NDU generator training.
preference: P starts at 0; after a nonmissing acquisition, increase by 1 on conflict with any earlier nonmissing report, otherwise decrease by 1; clip to {0,1,2,3}. gamma(P)=gamma_base*(1+P). Missingness does not change P.
risk_model: Calibration-only joint table over truth and four encoder-predicted symbols (8 classes plus missing). No test truth or corruption metadata reaches a policy.
terminal_portfolio: Quarter-grid convex combinations of acquired encoder symbols; uniform only if no report is present. Each combination actually enters the shared neural refinement and four neural decoders.
external_loss: Mean modality reconstruction error normalized by mean distinct-prototype squared distance, clipped at 2, plus 0.25 pairwise nearest-prototype disagreement. Fixed for every policy.
external_quality: Mean fraction of four generated modalities whose nearest canonical prototype equals the hidden world class. Also report attribute accuracy, ambiguity/omission, and contradiction independently.
same_objective_oracle: Independent bottom-up augmented-state DP must match recursive solver values and actions within 1e-10; parity is a correctness requirement, not a superiority claim.
selection: For each budget and seed choose gamma and static acquisition/weight policy on validation only by mean loss + 0.5 CVaR90. Freeze selections before producing heldout rows. Never select policies on test.

primary_comparison.confidence: 95% paired hierarchical bootstrap, seeds then worlds within seed, 1000 draws
additional_conditions: mean external quality drop no more than 0.02
mean standalone Linear MAC no more than 1.05 times baseline

secondary_claim: Incremental NDU preference value requires improvement against fixed-risk DP too; no such claim follows from beating a static policy alone.
frontier: Report empirical non-dominated observed quality-risk-cost points only. No global efficient-frontier claim and no test-set policy selection.
cost_accounting: Budget units are fixed acquisition proxies, not measured FLOPs. Separately report actual standalone Linear MAC for every encoder and final decoder, actual execution wall time, calibration/candidate generation/DP compilation cost and reuse. Test acquisition is lazy; unacquired modalities are not encoded. The independent oracle is audit-only.
test_integrity: Train and test world IDs are disjoint. Generator is trained once per seed and frozen for all arms. Preserve all seed outcomes and failed runs. Corrections after heldout inspection require explicit amendments and cannot turn the same test set into new independent evidence.
runtime_status_at_registration: Dedicated desktop probe run 39526325715 queued with no assigned runner. Local CPU execution can establish implementation and preliminary effects, not dedicated-cloud completion.
